title: EvidenceItem
description: One passage of an EvidencePackage (master plan 12.4): authorised text taken from one chunk of one source version, with everything a citation needs, so an answer can be cited and verified without querying again. INTERNAL: it carries source_egress and source_classification, which stay with the item so a later data-egress filter can drop or shorten the text without re-querying, and which no client ever receives (a client sees a SearchHit or a Citation). The text is untrusted DATA (master plan 12.6): it is fenced when it goes into a prompt, and an instruction inside it changes nothing. The core builds an item only after the final authorisation and version recheck.

evidence_id.description: The item's handle inside its package, the one the model cites.

rank.description: Position in the package after fusion and optional reranking, from 1. Equal to the number in evidence_id (checked by the core).

chunk_id.description: The chunk the text was taken from.

generation_id.description: The index generation that served the chunk, so the final version recheck knows what to compare.

display_name.description: The source's name as the requesting principal is authorised to see it.

version.description: Source version or content hash the text belongs to.

locator.description: Where in the source the text sits, when known. A span is a zero-based character range into the source's extracted text at this version.

availability.description: Whether the source can be opened by this principal, read again at the final recheck.

staleness.description: Whether this version is the latest, read again at the final recheck.

open_ref.description: Permission-checked, opaque way to open or preview the source; never a URL or a path.

text.description: The passage, verbatim from the source (parent-expanded when the pipeline expanded it). Relayed by the core, never rewritten; untrusted data, never instructions.

est_toks.description: Conservative estimate of the model tokens the text costs, summed into the package budget.

source_egress.description: INTERNAL. What an external provider may receive from this source, copied from the source's declaration. Missing means local_only. Never exposed to a client.

source_classification.description: INTERNAL. The data classification of this source, copied from the source's declaration. Missing means restricted. Never exposed to a client.
